name: Aït Melloul

queries.query: Ait Melloul Morocco official cadastral map parcel cadastre GIS land registry
queries.result: First-party discovery identified ANCFCC as Morocco's national land-conservation, cadastre, and cartography authority, its public cadastral-plan request service, the cadastral products page, and the official cartographic catalogue listing an AIT MELLOUL city topographic plan. No public anonymous parcel feature service was identified.

queries.query: Aït Melloul cadastre carte cadastrale officielle parcelles ANCFCC خريطة عقارية أيت ملول المسح العقاري
queries.result: First-party French and Arabic discovery identified the official ANCFCC cadastral/cartographic pages and the Agence Urbaine d'Agadir page confirming the homologated PA d'Ait Melloul. Search results also identified a local Inezgane–Ait Melloul conservation/cadastre office, but that contact listing was non-first-party and was not used as proof of a public data endpoint. No anonymous parcel geometry was exposed.

registryEvidence.custodian: ANCFCC is the evidenced national custodian. A city-local cadastral office for the Inezgane–Ait Melloul area was suggested by discovery, but no first-party local endpoint or usable public parcel service was established.
registryEvidence.scope: ANCFCC's official pages describe cadastral plans, cadastral index maps, and national cadastral coverage, while the online plan service requires title/cadastre identifiers and personal/payment/CAPTCHA workflow. This is custodial evidence, not a public citywide parcel API.
registryEvidence.scopeNote: General national-agency prose and a document-ordering workflow do not establish a public local registry endpoint; registryFound remains null.

parcelDiscovery.source: ANCFCC official cadastral and cartographic pages

attemptedRoutes.outcome: HTTP 200 HTML received, but the current page is a maintenance page with no usable cadastral form/API/configuration in the fetched HTML. No login, CAPTCHA interaction, personal data, title number, or payment flow was attempted.
HTTP 200 official French cadastral overview received; it describes ANCFCC's mandate and cadastral duties but exposes no anonymous parcel layer, schema, CRS, or geometry response.

HTTP 200 official product page received; it describes cadastral-plan and cadastral-index-map products, including Lambert-referenced map products, but provides no downloadable citywide parcel geometry or public query endpoint.
HTTP 200 official statistics page received; it states national digital cadastral-map coverage but does not expose a public parcel service.

Official catalogue was reachable and lists an AIT MELLOUL city topographic plan at 1/10,000 (2018, digital ID availability). It is cartographic/topographic product evidence, not parcel geometry or a parcel API.
HTTP 200 official Agence Urbaine d'Agadir page received; it lists the homologated PA d'Ait Melloul. This is urban-planning evidence, not cadastral parcel service evidence.
Not issued: no public parcel endpoint or client configuration was exposed. The exact WUP point was preserved and was not shifted or used as an absence test.

parcelDiscovery.note: No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax, account, or other unsafe fields were requested or retained. No TLS exception, credential, login, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, or private token was used. No GeoJSON sample was retained because no safe native parcel identity plus geometry response was obtained.
